item.title: Sumit Nagal To Lead India’s Challenge At The Milestone 10th Edition Of Bengaluru Open
item.description: Karnataka State Lawn Tennis Association: Top Indian player Sumit Nagal will lead the challenge in the men's singles competition of the landmark 10th edition of the Bengaluru Open, which is set to return from January 5 to 11, 2026, at the S.M. Krishna Tennis Stadium in Bengaluru. A flagship event on the ATP Challenger Tour, the tournament continues to grow in stature as one of India’s most prominent international tennis competitions.

item.title: Australia's Steve Smith Ruled Out Of Third Ashes Test
item.description: Australia's Steve Smith was ruled out of the third Ashes Test against England just before it started Wednesday with vertigo symptoms, but is expected to be available for the Boxing Day clash in Me

item.title: Cycling: Pune Grand Tour Unveils Its Heritage-inspired Trophy At National Capital
item.description: The Pune Grand Tour Trophy: The Pune Grand Tour 2026, India’s first-ever UCI 2.2 multi-stage road cycling race, on Tuesday unveiled its heritage-inspired Trophy at an august gathering in New Delhi.

item.title: Wayne Madsen To Lead Italy In T20 World Cup Next Year
item.description: The Italian Cricket Federation: The Italian Cricket Federation (Federazione Cricket Italia) have confirmed Wayne Madsen will lead the side for their historic ICC Men's T20 World Cup tilt next year, replacing Joe Burns who will be omitted from the squad for the tournament.

item.title: GOAT Tour: Lionel Messi Experiences Indian Tradition And Wildlife In A Visit To Vantara
item.description: Rodrigo De Paul: Global football icon Lionel Messi wrapped up his GOAT Tour 2025 with a special visit to Vantara, a wildlife rescue, rehabilitation, and conservation centre founded by Anant Ambani, near Jamnagar in Gujarat. Messi’s visit reflected this cultural ethos as he participated in traditional Hindu rituals, observed wildlife, and interacted with caregivers and conservation teams at the centre.

item.title: Livingstone Stars as Abu Dhabi Knight Riders Hand Desert Vipers First Defeat in One-Run Thriller
item.description: Abu Dhabi Knight Riders handed Desert Vipers their first defeat of the season with a dramatic one-run win at Zayed Cricket Stadium, powered by Liam Livingstone’s 76 and a nerveless bowling effort.

item.title: All India Civil Services Lawn Tennis Tournament 2025–26 Begins In Gandhinagar
item.description: All India Civil Services Lawn: The All India Civil Services Lawn Tennis Tournament 2025–26 was formally inaugurated in Gandhinagar by Gujarat Chief Secretary M.K. Das.

item.title: ‘He Fits The Position Perfectly,’ PBKS Skipper Shreyas Iyer On Buying Connolly In Auction
item.description: Shreyas Iyer: Punjab Kings (PBKS) captain Shreyas Iyer spoke about acquiring batting all-rounder Cooper Connolly, stating that the Australian has the ability to finish matches and fits the role perfectly.

item.title: TPL 7 Champions Sofia, Jeevan Of GS Delhi Aces Call Ahmedabad’s Atmosphere ‘electric And Energetic’
item.description: Tennis Premier League Season: GS Delhi Aces concluded their debut season triumphantly by winning the Tennis Premier League Season 7 title, showcasing a strong performance from the very first day till the final.

item.title: After Trading Jaddu, We Needed A No.7 Who Bats, Bowl and Field: CSK CEO On Prashant Veer’s Record Bid
item.description: Chennai Super Kings: Chennai Super Kings (CSK) CEO Kasi Viswanathan opened up about the team purchasing uncapped all-rounder Prashant Veer at the IPL mini-auction, stating that they were looking for a new No. 7 player after trading Ravindra Jadeja to Rajasthan Royals.
